abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging is an essential tool for the assessment of the scrotum, particularly in cases with inconclusive ultrasound findings. It has a great capacity to differentiate between intratesticular and extratesticular lesions, as well as between neoplastic and non-neoplastic lesions. By providing an accurate characterization of lesions, magnetic resonance imaging plays a crucial role in preoperative tumor staging and decision-making. This pictorial essay highlights the key non-neoplastic and neoplastic testicular pathologies, as evaluated by magnetic resonance imaging. The recognition of these pathologies underscores the role the radiologists play in the care of patients with scrotal lesions, by providing an appropriate evaluation of the relevant imaging characteristics.
abstract_ja: 磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)は陰嚢の評価、特に超音波検査の所見が不確実な場合に不可欠なツールです。精巣内病変と精巣外病変、および腫瘍性病変と非腫瘍性病変を区別する優れた能力があります。磁気共鳴画像法は病変の正確な特性化を提供することで、術前の病期分類と診断決定に重要な役割を果たします。本図解エッセイは、磁気共鳴画像法で評価した重要な非腫瘍性および腫瘍性精巣病変を強調しています。これらの病変の認識は、陰嚢病変患者のケアにおける放射線科医の役割を強調し、関連する画像特性の適切な評価を提供することの重要性を示しています。
